runtimeAssumption: Immediate accepted native frames; no congestion simulation. Per-trip requests paced 1/sec,2 in-flight; actual received geometry only, no retroactive union.
limitations: GPS error scores exclude missing/unbracketed same-trip axis history; separate raw-target lag is not GPS truth accuracy.
Every hidden relocation counts as an unresolved perceived teleport.
World vector derivatives include piecewise route curvature; scalar correction bounds do not bound route tangent changes.

cold-baseline.geometryCaveat: Actual captured geometry receipts; provisional seeds and pertrip refinement. Harness loader concurrency differs from native scheduler.
cold-baseline.legacyMetricCaveat: Legacy top-level slew/hold counters retain the historical discontinuity filter for comparison only. Use completeDisplayAudit for every actual frame, correction, both acceleration signs and visibility.

completeDisplayAudit.note: Every submitted replay state counted, including server-sanctioned resets. Displacement-derived speed around a reset describes visible teleport, not physical tram speed. Crossings are descriptive, not proof that a source-designated served/express/terminal stop should have held.
completeDisplayAudit.rawGpsTargetNote: Receipt-time separation from the latest GPS target while no route axis is available, not timestamp-matched position accuracy. Includes stale input and fade stages.
completeDisplayAudit.worldVectorNote: Finite differences of actual longitude/latitude positions, including raw GPS retargets, lateral alignment and route curvature. Route vertices can exceed correction-only acceleration/jerk bounds; no geometry-change exemption.

cold-baseline.caveat: Sampled captured inputs, known geometry-pack trips only. No rider ground truth; source timestamps and delivery timing preserved. CPU is Node on host, not Hermes/native rendering.
